title: A $\mathbb{Z}_2$-Topological Framework for Sign-rank Lower Bounds
summary: We develop a topological framework for proving lower bounds on sign-rank via $\mathbb{Z}_2$-equivariant topology, and use it to resolve the sign-rank of the Gap Hamming Distance problem up to lower-order terms. For every (partial) sign matrix $A$, we associate a free $\mathbb{Z}_2$-simplicial complex $S(A)$ and show that sign-rank of $A$ is characterized by the linear analog of $\mathbb{Z}_2$-index of $S(A)$.
